jobs.used_in: 도감·카드 — 지금 게임에 자리 없음: 후보 ⓐ 무늬 등급 알림 «✨ N번째 잎 — 등급» 옆 그림 ⓑ 잎·삽수 팔기 확인 시트 ⓒ 앞으로 도감 · 지금 바로 docs/dogam 식물 칸 · 핑크프린세스 · 무지

params.prompt: A single Philodendron 'Pink Princess' heart-shaped leaf, front view seen straight on (flat, like a pressed specimen), the whole leaf centered and filling about 80% of a square frame, the short petiole attached at the notch at the TOP of the leaf (the sinus) - no stem at the pointed tip, isolated on a transparent background. Keep the leaf shape of image 1 but make it COMPLETELY PLAIN: one solid, uniform dark green with a slight burgundy tint over the whole leaf, a mid-dark value (clearly lighter than black), veins only a little lighter so the leaf stays readable. Absolutely no streaks, no marbling, no lighter patches, no pink, no variegation of any kind. Draw it as a 2D hand-drawn storybook illustration in the style of image 2: thin warm-brown ink outline, soft gouache and watercolor wash, gentle pastel tones, light paper grain only inside the leaf. No pot, no text, no border, no drop shadow, not a photo, not a 3D render.

jobs.why: 1차 무지 카드에 옅은 초록 줄무늬가 났다(무지가 무늬로 읽힘) · 밝기 0.17~0.19 < 0.25 · 잎끝 줄기 — 글을 «완전 민무늬 · 홈에 잎자루»로
